liz: quick flag — new quantized reranker (q4x) rollout shows ~0.017 MRR regression in prod A/B for cohort B but our local harness shows +0.22 MRR. NDCG is mostly flat. seems concentrated on docs that mix markdown code fences, inline HTML snippets, and lots of short inline links. dan: can you paste one redacted example that reproduces the mismatch? liz: redacted example below (sanitized): ```json { \"query\": \"validate stripe webhook signature\", \"doc_id\": \"doc-77\", \"title\": \"Webhook signature verification\", \"body_md\": \"### Example\\n```js\\nconst sig = req.headers['stripe-signature']\\n// verify...\\n```\\n

See also: security guide

\\nMore: {\\\"example\\\": 123}\\n\", \"body_text\": \"Example const sig = req.headers['stripe-signature'] // verify... See also: security guide More: {\\\"example\\\": 123}\" } ``` liz: prod serving pipeline currently concatenates `title + body_md` (raw markdown) before tokenization. our offline harness used `title + body_text` (stripped plaintext). tokenization differences + quant noise flip low-margin ranks. marco: also worth checking tokenizer versions — prod is on tokenizer v1.8, harness upgraded to v2.0 last week. v2.0 splits punctuation in code fences differently which changes token counts inside the useful snippet. quantized logits are tighter so tiny tokenization deltas flip rank-1 candidates -> MRR sensitive. dan: tie-breaker semantics may matter too. prod tie-break falls back to `last_indexed` timestamp, harness stable-sorts by candidate id. near-ties get resolved differently. qa-bot: Quick repro job queued: https://ci.internal/6218001111/jobs/99 :gear: marco: repro plan i ran locally: 1) run harness with serving concat (title+body_md) 2) pin tokenizer to v1.8 3) set tie-breaker to `last_indexed` 4) use candidate-prune point same as prod (pre-encoder topk=90). command: ``` ./eval_harness --model reranker:q4x --cohort mixed-md-html-links.jsonl \ --preproc=serving_concat_md --tokenizer=v1.8 \ --tie-break=last_indexed --prune-point=pre-encoder --topk=90 \ --metrics mrr,ndcg --bootstrap=2000 --out=/tmp/md_repro.json ``` marco: with those knobs synced i reproduce ~-0.016 MRR (close to prod). forcing `body_text` or increasing topk to 200 makes harness show positive lift again. liz: so root cause is mismatch in input canonicalization (raw md vs stripped text) + tokenizer version + prune point. small quant noise amplifies these differences. dan: short-term mitigation: change serving to prefer `body_text` when present (low-risk) and add a canary rollout. medium-term: update onboarding checklist to require: a) run harness with both raw and stripped doc variants, b) pin tokenizer version parity across staging/prod, c) include `md-html-links` slice in regression monitors. marco: filing PR #1542 with harness cohort + unit test golden containing code fences + inline links. i'll also add a bootstrap-based regression alert on the slice (alert if MRR drop > 0.01 over 30m). qa-bot: PR CI started -> https://ci.internal/6218001111/jobs/100 :white_check_mark: liz: i'll open the hotfix to prefer `body_text` in serving (30m canary, rollback plan). dan please update onboarding doc with tie-breaker and prune-point checks. dan: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
